note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. Every building, space and participant is generic and fictional; only the supplied relationships are drawn, with their kind, and none carries an arrowhead. Nothing states who may attend, a secrecy or confidentiality rule, a vote, a hierarchy, a time span or any outcome. Long-labels-stress: capped under the standing coordinator rule (2026-09-26, from LAW-0687/0689-0692; AUTHORING item 20). (1) Text lengths: near-maximum texts at 1:1 gave people 48.4 px (< 60); the capped texts give 61.5 px. (2) Relationship count (round 2, after the reviewer's traceability rule: every relation label >= 20 px nearer its own line than any other, no line under a label): with six relationships the labels cannot all be placed traceably in any ratio at >= 16.6 px (16:9 17.1 px with 1 failing label; 9:16 and 1:1 failing), with five 9:16 and 1:1 still fail; four relationships (the baseline count) place traceably in every ratio (16:9 19.8 px, 9:16 21.6 px, 1:1 16.6 px, people 70.8-73.7 px). Fallbacks tried first: bracket levels packed by span and label width, labels on either side of their line and slid along it, card widths 1/4.6-1/6.6, card gaps 1.2/2.4 em, names carried on the cards, legend in 3-5 columns, a right-hand text column, room depths 230-820. Every capped field stays longer than its baseline counterpart; counts stay >= baseline (4 participants vs 3, 4 relationships vs 4).
